text:
Eli: quick thread — MicroProof wants a tiny compliance bundle for POC: SOC2 storage/network excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, 48h presign for uploads, and a clear Dedicated overage line. Can we do this today?
Nora: I can slice the SOC2 controls (storage + network) and produce a one-paragraph plain-English summary. Will redact hostnames.
Jamaal: Legal/pen-test: need vendor name + exact scan scope + POC contact to sign the attestation. Also confirm presign retention.
Eli: vendor = SkyScan. Contact = secops@microproof.com. Scope = external app + single staging subnet. Retention: they requested auto-delete after 10 days.
Priya: I'll issue a 48h presign URL (default 24h but can do 48h after legal). Command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/microproof/poc.zip --expires-in 172800`
Jamaal: 48h ok. Deletion 10 days OK if we document scheduled purge in the message. I'll draft the one-line attestation and sign once SOC2 snippet is redacted.
Nora: SOC2 snippet ready, redacted, includes control IDs + EU residency note. Uploading to thread.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: do not include raw logs or internal topology diagrams in external excerpts. Include redaction and retention notes.
Priya: Presign URL: https://s3-presign.example/mp-5188-48h (expires in 48h). Auto-delete scheduled in 10 days.
Eli: Sent package to secops@microproof.com with the SOC2 excerpt, signed attestation (Jamaal signed), presign link, and a short line-item: "Dedicated bursts billed at 20% uplift above committed rate for short bursts; bespoke quote available."
MicroProof (via email): "thanks — uploading now. Can you confirm we won't keep copies beyond 10 days?"
Jamaal: Confirmed: uploads auto-deleted after 10 days, contact support@redwood.com for retention exceptions.
Eli: Perfect. Closing thread once upload completes. :thumbsup:
